scripts.test:contract: schemathesis run openapi.yaml --url http://localhost:3001 --max-examples 25 -H "Origin: http://localhost:5173" -H "X-Service-Key: contract-test-service-key" --exclude-checks unsupported_method,positive_data_acceptance,negative_data_rejection --warnings missing_test_data,missing_deserializer,unused_openapi_auth,unsupported_regex,method_not_allowed,constants_extraction
scripts.test:zap: docker run --rm -t -v "%CD%/test-results:/zap/wrk" ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t http://host.docker.internal:3000 -r zap-baseline.html -J zap-baseline.xml
